role: A minecart carrying a MobSpawnerBaseLogic: it rides rails ticking the spawner, renders as a mob spawner block, and reads/writes the spawner logic in its NBT.
scope_reason: world.conf sets minecarts = off: carts cannot be placed and mineshaft chest carts are never spawned, so no minecart entity of any type exists, in the oracle too (SPEC 'Unsupported features are world switches').

members.name: mobSpawnerLogic
members.note: forwards world/position to the cart and setEntityState for the spawn-particle byte

members.name: handleHealthUpdate
members.note: setDelayToMin from the client particle byte

notes: Despite living in the ai package this is a minecart entity, not a task; its spawner logic is TileEntityMobSpawner's MobSpawnerBaseLogic.
